1. /app/data/background/citySet_with_states.txt - find all cities mapped to Ohio
2. For each Ohio city found, check if there's data in restaurants, accommodations, attractions, and distance matrix CSVs
3. Also check what data exists for Minneapolis

Read the citySet_with_states.txt file first, then grep for Ohio cities in each CSV file. Report all Ohio cities and what data is available for each.
